description_en: Queries the details of a cloud recording download task by task ID, including the start time, recording progress, recording type, and download URL
description_zh: 调用该接口按任务ID查询云端录像下载任务的详细信息，包括起始时间、录像进度、录像类型和下载地址等
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-record-download-job-by-id --iot-instance-id Iot-r000000 --job-id w2s000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRecordDownloadJobById

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab of the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud recording download task
parameters.name: job_id

Code.description_en:
The status code of the call.

If the call is successful, 200 is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see Error codes below
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：

调用成功，返回200。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647
BeginTime.description_zh: 查询范围起始时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围为0~2147483647

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647
EndTime.description_zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。 取值范围为0~2147483647

FileName.description_en: The file name. This parameter is returned when Type is 1
FileName.description_zh: 文件名，Type为1时，显示该参数

JobErrorCode.description_en:
The error reason of the task. This parameter is returned when Status is -1.

9441: Network exception.
9442: Audio or video data error
JobErrorCode.description_zh:
任务异常原因，当Status为-1时返回异常信息：

9441：网络异常。
9442：音视频数据错误

Progress.description_en: The generation progress of the recording file. Valid values: 0 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 录像文件生成进度，范围为0~100

RecordType.description_en:
The recording type.

0: Continuous recording.
1: Event-triggered recording.
2: Active recording.
4: Local-to-cloud recording.
99: Mixed type
RecordType.description_zh:
录像类型。

0：连续录像。
1：事件录像。
2：主动录像。
4：本地上云录像。
99：混合类型

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the recording file.

-1: The recording file generation is abnormal.
0: The recording file has been generated.
1: The recording file is being generated
Status.description_zh:
录像文件的生成状态。

-1：录像文件生成异常。
0：录像文件已生成完毕。
1：录像文件正在生成中

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type.

0: Main stream.
1: Sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型。

0：主码流。
1：辅码流

Type.description_en:
The download type.

1: Download by file.
2: Download device cloud recordings by time range.
3: Download device local recordings by time range
Type.description_zh:
下载类型。

1：按文件下载。
2：设备云端录像按时间范围下载。
3：设备本地录像按时间范围下载

Url.description_en: The download URL of the cloud recording. The URL is valid for 1 hour
Url.description_zh: 云端录像下载地址，有效期为1小时

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
